title: Aabid radd roya
body:
ummat neh qaid kithiya hay phuppiya berida thayo abid rad roya
bardash kar na sakiya
gairat da eh khuda
kithe majma laeena da kithe zahra deeya paliya moo wala naal kaj ke bazaara wich khariyaa
mangdi rahi burkhe roo roo
konain dee malika
zainab deh kuthbe sun keh hasde c shami sare tohfe samajh ke pathar jadoo qaidiya noo mare
wala noo zakhmi keeta
bejurm be kathaa
sir nange rulaya eh kul nabiya dee gairat noo kalma go wah kitha sharminda sharafat noo
neze teh ray eh rondi
abbas dee wafaa
injh shimmer kamine neh ik zulam kamaya eh injh gore deh zabra ich sakina noo turaya eh
chow saal dee ujri daa
koi kitha na hayaa
sajjad muhari noo ah kehdiyaa mastoora kithe jaye dasa sakoo zakhma deh naal choor ah
kalee fizza sariya noo
kewe dewe hosla
sajjad neh wekhe neh akhtar oh zulam sare kewe shimmer layee neh gore edee paak kand teh mare
fir vi na moo cho nikali
ummat lay badua
